label: nyiso 75 solar shape
definition: nyiso-75 (STRUCTURAL FIX, rule 1 [R-STRUCT]): shaped solar fallback. EIA-930 NYIS files `NG: SUN` as all zeros, so NYISO solar fell through to the EIA-930 generation-distribution parquet, whose NYISO solar row is a SINGLE repeated value across all 8760 h — the model generated as much solar at 03:00 as at noon (midday/night 1.00, 12 distinct values = the 12-step EIA-860 monthly capacity ramp). Swept all six ISOs x {wind,solar} x 2023-2025: this is the ONLY cell that both reaches this fallback and is degenerate; the other 30 ISO-year-mode cells are byte-identical. The row is now repaired from an adjacent same-clock BA (NEISO: interconnected, both America/New_York, EIA-860 solar-fleet latitude 42.5N vs 42.6N), which carries the measured diurnal timing, cloud variability and seasonality; it is then corrected for the two fleets' EIA-860 tracking mixes (NYISO 30.5% single-axis vs NEISO 13.3%) by the clear-sky POA RATIO POA_iso/POA_donor, which is phase-free because the geometry helper's omitted longitude/EoT term cancels between the two ISOs. LEVEL IS UNTOUCHED: the distribution is renormalized to sum to 1.0, so the annual mean CF stays exactly RENEWABLE_AVG_CF (0.1500), zero clipped hours. NOTHING FITTED TO A RESIDUAL. Validated against EIA-923 NYIS utility-scale solar monthly netgen (data never used to build the shape), 2023 monthly-energy share: flat MAE 0.0304 r -0.043 -> donor-only MAE 0.0076 r 0.977 -> this fix MAE 0.0050 r 0.983. Solar 2023 now resolves 4,576 distinct values (was 12), peaks h13 (was h00), midday/night 83.9 (was 1.00). KEEPER (promoted 2026-07-26 on EXPLICIT OWNER OVERRIDE, rule 1 [R-STRUCT] structural fidelity — the same basis nyiso-72 itself was promoted on). It REPLACES 2026-07-23-nyiso-72-netrev-margin, whose solar day was the flat row and which is therefore NO LONGER REPRODUCIBLE from current code (the fix is live on main, PR #2903 / af74927, and also changes NYISO solar in FORECAST mode). SCORING: C6 governance PASS (attestation carried forward from nyiso-72 with a solar-shape governance paragraph; DOF ledger 16 entries / 6 residual). C7/C8 PASS, C2/C4 PASS, C3a/C3b/C3c unchanged-FAIL (the known 2023 energy-LEVEL residual). Determination NOT-YET — unchanged in class from nyiso-72, which was NOT-YET on C3a/C3b/C3c independently of C1. C1 flips PASS->FAIL on ONE knife-edge cell — 2024 ST_GAS -3.021 TWh against a +/-3.01 TWh band, i.e. OVER BY 0.011 TWh (0.4% of the band). This is NOT a regression from the solar shape: the fix moved model ST_GAS by only -0.056 TWh (8.106 -> 8.050, 0.7% of the class) and nyiso-72 was ALREADY at -2.965, just 0.045 TWh (1.5% of the band) inside the edge; both bundles resolve the same benchmark hash eia923-465c3e2cf4a5. The underlying ST_GAS under-run is large, PRE-EXISTING and GROWING (-1.83 / -3.02 / -5.12 TWh across 2023/2024/2025). Note the 2025 cell — the worst by far — is SKIPPED, not passed (preliminary EIA-923 vintage, 3/10 ST_GAS plants reporting), so the nyiso-72 C1 14/14 rested on 2023+2024 only and was already due to break as that vintage finalizes. ROOT CAUSE DIAGNOSED AND CHARTERED, NOT UNKNOWN: it is a Long Island / NYC in-city LOAD-POCKET MUST-RUN gap (FINDING-nyiso-stgas-underrun-diagnosis-2026-07-23.md) — economic and heat-rate causes are RULED OUT (HR = EIA-860 design HR; the model already prices the LI pocket above the steam's mc) and the reliability floor is pinned from both sides. Per rules 1/13/23 nothing was tuned to close it; the forward lever is a published Zone-J/Zone-K minimum in-city generation requirement, chartered as nyiso-76 (docs/handoffs/nyiso-incity-mustrun-charter-2026-07.md). Single code delta vs the nyiso-72 keeper recipe (replay_keeper); no config change, no new intake.
